findings.finding_id: P1-1 REPAIR: change only GitHubRestPort._request and EXTEND (do not rewrite) tests/unit/test_orchestration_dev_github_port_redirects.py. When urllib rejects a redirect before the handler runs (non-http Location scheme; malformed or invalid bracketed-host Location) raise AdapterError AFTER leaving the except block, so message, __cause__ and __context__ hold no Location URL or query. Keep URLError, timeout and JSON errors unchanged. New tests must fail on aee2026b
findings.message: PR #1050 IV verdict on aee2026b; owner confirmed P1 and Option B (2026-10-03): Location data reachable through attributes of an exception chained via __cause__/__context__ counts as exposure.

findings.finding_id: P1-2 DETACH: nothing reachable from the raised AdapterError via __cause__ or __context__ may hold a Location URL or query in any attribute (headers, url, filename, fp). If an HTTPError has a Location header or its url is not the request URL, raise AdapterError with the same '-> <status>' message AFTER leaving the except block, no cause/context: redirect loop limit, POST 307/308, same-origin redirect then 4xx/5xx. Other HTTPErrors keep 'from exc'. Tests walk the chain and fail on aee2026b
